limitations: This is finite source admission only. No product/parser/producer/query/evaluator/build/test/inference code was executed, and no Anvil, Git, source, environment, provider, installation or live serving state was mutated.

The 13 controls are admitted future requirements, not measured outcomes. Implementation/CLI/HTTP/view parity, source forgery resistance, cursor fencing, captured membership validation, saved projections, accessibility, resource bounds and CI remain untested here.

There is no admitted contract-cycle, contract high-fanout or mixed lexical/contract multihop gold in this packet. Existing P1 regression fixtures do not become contract truth. New joined-path claims require separately frozen and source-admitted cases.
Unknown dependencies are conservative reconsideration candidates and do not measure precision/recall, runtime transport, historical/deployment closure, execution order or completeness.

T021 dependency/status, T069 implementation/task acceptance, real agent/human UX, scale/resource, install, CI and release gates remain separate. The coordinator-supplied E000859 acceptance receipt was not read back in Anvil.

binding_interpretation: Path membership selects dependency/judgment rows only. Unknowns gain zero exact targets and zero contract reachability hops.

Canonical endpoint candidates must share contract ID and canonical scoped identity, use the opposite role and the server owner; duplicate endpoints remain dependencies only. Queue consumer service remains explicit.
Direct baseline reverse membership inverts only the four original qualified physical pairs. The already-frozen SOURCE-ADD mutation supplies its separately inherited fifth pair.
